distilled_patterns.description: Agent embeds conversational prefaces or narrative explanatory text inside the answer call, which exceeds evaluation boundaries or truncates the target entity.
distilled_patterns.effect: Caused 9 out of 14 failures in Iteration 1 (including flipping task 778). Enforce strict isolated entity output with zero commentary or markdown wrappers.

distilled_patterns.description: Agent repeatedly issues non-productive queries past step 15, exhausting the turn budget without converging on an answer.
distilled_patterns.effect: Caused 4 failures (including flipping task 805). Impose hard convergence stop by step 15-18 to submit best grounded candidate.

distilled_patterns.description: Search queries with overly narrow phrases or quotation marks fail to return snippets, leading to query cycling instead of page inspection.
distilled_patterns.effect: Stalls retrieval; broad 2-4 noun queries and immediate candidate page inspection prevent zero-result loops.
